BEFORE WE SAY HELLO

Your questions,
answered.

Where do you offer home services?+

We serve Dubai, Sharjah and Ajman. Please confirm availability for your exact location on WhatsApp before booking.

Who can book?+

Our services are for ladies and couples only. Contact us to arrange a couples session and confirm availability.

How do I book, reschedule or cancel?+

Use our Setmore booking page to view available appointments and manage your booking. Please confirm cancellation terms with the team before payment.

What should I tell my therapist?+

Share your comfort preferences and any relevant health conditions, recent procedures, pregnancy, skin sensitivity or injuries before your session. The team can discuss suitability; seek medical guidance when appropriate.

Are results guaranteed?+

Experiences vary by individual. Our services focus on wellness and relaxation; no specific body change or medical outcome is guaranteed.
